## Follow-up Duration {#sec-followup}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
all_analysis_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = patient_max_t)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 4, fill = "#003865") +
  scale_x_continuous("Follow-up [Weeks]", breaks = seq(0, 200, 26)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Patients") +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Distribution of patient follow-up duration (calendar weeks).](data-exploration_files/figure-html/fig-followup-duration-1.png){#fig-followup-duration width=768}
:::
:::


## SLD Measurements {#sec-sld}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
visit_data |>
  filter(!is.na(mmsumdiam)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = mmsumdiam, group = usubjid)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3, color = "#003865") +
  scale_x_continuous("Weeks") +
  scale_y_continuous("SLD [mm]") +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Observed SLD trajectories for all patients (mm sum of diameters).](data-exploration_files/figure-html/fig-sld-observations-1.png){#fig-sld-observations width=960}
:::
:::


## Survival Follow-up {#sec-survival}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
all_analysis_data |>
  distinct(usubjid, pfs, right_censored) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pfs, fill = !right_censored)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 4, position = "stack") +
  scale_x_continuous("PFS [Weeks]", breaks = seq(0, 200, 26)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Patients") +
  scale_fill_manual("Event", values = c("TRUE" = "#F0AB00", "FALSE" = "#003865"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "Progression/Death", "FALSE" = "Censored")) +
  NULL
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![PFS distribution by censoring status.](data-exploration_files/figure-html/fig-survival-followup-1.png){#fig-survival-followup width=768}
:::
:::
